title: First Week Checklist
summary: Your main mission: find the places every new student needs in their first week. Do them in any order.
teaches: Where to eat, study, get help and get off campus

steps.label: Meet an Orientation Leader
steps.hint: There's one just inside the Webster Avenue gate and one on Edwards Parade.
say: Checklist: you met an Orientation Leader.

steps.label: Grab a meal at McShane
say: Checklist: McShane's Marketplace is the main dining hall.

steps.label: Find a place to study
say: Checklist: Walsh Library is the main library.

steps.label: Find help if you're sick or stressed
steps.hint: O'Hare Hall, on the east side, has the Health Center and Counseling Center.
say: Checklist: O'Hare Hall has the Health Center and the Counseling Center.

steps.label: Find Public Safety
say: Checklist: Public Safety is in Thebaud Hall.

steps.label: Learn how to get around and off campus
steps.hint: Ride the Campus Shuttle (reading a shuttle stop's sign counts too), and read the Webster Avenue gate's sign.
say: Checklist: the Campus Shuttle gets you around Rose Hill, and the Webster Avenue gate (Metro-North) gets you off campus.

steps.label: Find your classes
steps.hint: Visit two of Keating, Dealy, Hughes and Freeman Halls.
say: Checklist: you found where classes happen.

done_say: You finished the First Week Checklist! You know where to eat, study, get help and get round.
Check your orientation schedule for what's on this week. Welcome to Fordham!
